items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: The best one I had, it was a year, a night before that. They call him Alexander... Adolph Alexander.

ctx.x: How long have you spent sometimes with one pupil? I mean, have you worked with one boy over many years? Or is it just a matter of months? How long does it usually take for you to teach somebody? Well... What's the longest you ever took?
The best one I had, it was a year, a night before that. They call him Alexander. Alexander?
